The Government of Vietnam Proposes a Pilot Visa for Remote Workers

Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Lam Thi Phuong Thanh presented a draft resolution on special mechanisms and policies for tourism development to the National Assembly. The draft proposes a controlled pilot program for foreigners working remotely in Vietnam. It also includes more flexible visa and residency conditions for medical tourists and individuals coming for long-term treatment, rehabilitation, or relaxation, along with accompanying family members.

The proposal aims to attract higher-spending tourists and strengthen the competitiveness of the tourism industry. The draft includes the expansion of bilateral visa-free regimes for key markets and a more flexible visa policy prioritizing high-income, long-stay, and repeat visitors, as well as conference participants. The government also proposes simplifying the issuance of work permits, visas, and temporary residence for foreign experts and artists involved in tourism projects.

The pilot program for remote workers has not yet been adopted. The Culture and Social Affairs Committee of the National Assembly, while assessing the project, noted that the resolution should not establish specific visa rules for separate groups and called for further clarification on the novelty, features, and boundaries of the proposed special visa policy. Specific rules, fees, and application procedures for the pilot visa have not been established. Remote workers will continue to use the standard electronic visa valid for up to 90 days.

📌 Atomic Swaps: Exchanging Crypto Without Trusting an Intermediary

Main Points
⏺ Atomic swaps allow participants to exchange assets without handing funds to a centralized custodian
⏺ The mechanism is designed so both sides receive their assets or the exchange doesn't complete
⏺ This post explains why atomic swaps are an interesting approach to decentralized trading

1️⃣ Core Idea — two users want to exchange assets from different blockchains without trusting an exchange or intermediary with their funds.
2️⃣ How It Works — one approach uses cryptographic secrets and time restrictions to coordinate an exchange under predefined rules.
3️⃣ Main Advantage — participants don't need to transfer custody of their assets to a third party during the exchange.
4️⃣ The Challenges — networks need compatible mechanisms, while participants need liquidity, time, and correct execution.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — before swapping, review fees on both chains, lock periods, technical requirements, and refund conditions.

Final Thoughts

Atomic swaps aim to solve a fundamental crypto problem: how to exchange value with a stranger without relying on their honesty.

Nvidia CEO Scandal Could Send Shockwaves Through the U.S. Economy 🕵️‍♂️

A controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang could extend far beyond Silicon Valley, raising questions about corporate security, national intelligence and the future of America’s technology industry.

The headline-grabbing allegations involving Huang and a woman reportedly suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence have drawn attention to the potential risks facing one of the world’s most influential technology companies. While the claims require independent verification, the situation highlights how personal relationships involving senior executives can become matters of national and economic concern.

Nvidia occupies a central position in the global artificial intelligence race. Its advanced chips power data centers, AI development and critical computing infrastructure used by businesses and governments around the world. 

Any controversy affecting the company’s leadership could therefore attract scrutiny from investors, regulators and national security officials. The broader concern is particularly significant amid growing tensions between Washington and Beijing. The United States has tightened controls on advanced semiconductor exports to China, while policymakers increasingly view access to AI technology as a strategic priority.

For investors, the key question is whether the allegations could trigger reputational damage, additional scrutiny or uncertainty surrounding Nvidia’s corporate governance. 

Even without direct consequences for the company’s operations, a high-profile controversy could influence market confidence. 

The case also underscores a growing challenge for major technology companies: their executives are no longer operating solely in the commercial arena. 

Their decisions, relationships and public image can carry implications for international security and economic stability. With Nvidia playing such a central role in the AI boom, any disruption involving its leadership could attract attention well beyond the company’s shareholders.

👀 Justin Sun becomes PEPE’s largest individual holder, Arkham says 

🌐 Tron founder Justin Sun has accumulated nearly 3% of PEPE’s supply, with blockchain analytics firm Arkham Intelligence identifying approximately $51.25 million worth of the memecoin across his known and suspected wallets. According to an October 27 Arkham Intelligence report, the tokens entered Sun-linked wallets over the previous 10 days, making him the largest individual PEPE holder outside cryptocurrency exchanges.

🔗 The firm estimated his combined holdings at 2.82% of PEPE’s supply, although some wallets included in its calculations were attributed to Sun through blockchain analysis. At the time, PEPE had a market capitalization of approximately $1.81 billion, with exchanges controlling several of the largest known holdings.

📊 Binance held $337.5 million worth of PEPE, representing 18.7% of the supply, followed by Robinhood with $150.9 million, or 8.37%. Coinbase and OKX accounted for another 5.03% and 4.15%, respectively. Unlike Sun’s attributed holdings, exchange balances generally include assets held on behalf of customers, meaning their large positions do not necessarily represent investments made by the platforms themselves.
